title: implementer report
description: What the implementer changed on the branch. The supervisor reads this to decide whether the code phase passed.

summary.description: Two or three sentences: what was implemented and why.

branch.description: The branch the work landed on, e.g. fix/issue-57.

commits.description: The commits pushed for this phase, newest last.

deviations.description: Where the implementation departed from the plan, and why. Empty when it followed the plan.

pull_request.description: Number of the pull request opened or updated, when there is one.

issue_comment_url.description: URL of the comment the implementer left on the issue.

blocked.description: True when the implementer could not finish (missing access, unresolvable build failure).

blocker_reason.description: Why the implementer is blocked. Only meaningful when blocked is true.
